title: riemann-lean-verify: pre-registered, reproducible verification of a published Lean 4 formalization claiming the Riemann Hypothesis
description: Tooling, records and pre-registered criteria for an independent check of a published Lean 4 formalization that claims to prove the Riemann Hypothesis. The criteria for a verdict were fixed before the outcome was known (see PREREGISTRATION.md). The proof's source is not redistributed; the tooling downloads it and checks a recorded SHA-256.
